title: BootResults
description: The --infeasible file of servtuner propose: the boot probes made so far, each a deployment with no load. An infeasible result rules out every configuration whose knobs contain its knobs. A feasible result must name every feasibility knob of the search space; its c_kv, below the space's min_concurrency, drops the configuration. The probe of a combination is the base knobs plus the feasibility knobs' values.

knobs.description: The knob set that was booted. servtuner propose rejects an empty one: it would match every configuration.

reason.description: Why it did not boot: the last log lines or the exit reason.

c_kv.description: The concurrency the KV cache can hold, from num_gpu_blocks in vllm:cache_config_info; for a feasible boot.

num_gpu_blocks.description: The KV cache's size in vLLM blocks, or SGLang's KV pool in pages (max_total_num_tokens / page_size): boots of equal size are one configuration.

vllm_version.description: vLLM's version as its /version reported it, for a feasible boot. A tuning session reusing this boot on a host checks it against the version the host's launcher reports.

tuningKvSizing.description: How vLLM's extensible KV cache was sized at boot (vLLM 0.34+), read from its log lines `Free memory on device ... on startup` and `Memory after warmup ...`. GiB values are as vLLM logged them, to 0.01 GiB.

bound.description: Which limit sized the cache: `utilization` when gpu_memory_utilization x total memory was the smaller, `memory` when the memory free after warmup (less vLLM's margin) was. Under `memory`, a higher gpu_memory_utilization gives no more KV cache.

memory_limit_gib.description: The free-memory limit before the transient reserve: free after warmup plus committed, less the margin.

utilization_limit_gib.description: The gpu_memory_utilization limit before the transient reserve: requested less what vLLM uses besides the cache.
